chunks: It is well-known among the companions that it is the prayer of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, as in the narration of al-Mufaddal.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: the prayer being identified and attributed
key_terms.ٱلْأَصْحَابِ: the companions or fellow scholars/transmitters being referred to in context
key_terms.ٱلْمَشْهُورُ: the well-known or widely recognized view

ai.seo_question: What is the well-known view among the companions regarding this prayer?
ai.summary: This passage states that the well-known view among the companions is that this prayer is attributed to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام. It also notes that this attribution appears in the narration of al-Mufaddal, indicating a transmitted basis for that identification.
